_readme: Exposure settings, one entry per target image, keyed by filename stem with no extension. Exposure depends on the physical target and scene, not on which hologram-generation method is running, so one file serves every method used on this rig. Values are human-readable -- what you read off the camera's own screen while metering by hand; exposure_lookup.py converts them to the EDSDK hex codes canon_camera.py's set_iso/set_tv expect. There is no Av field: this rig has a bare sensor with no lens, so aperture is not controllable. ISO: 'default_iso' is set once at the top and each target leaves its own 'iso' null to inherit it; fill in a target's own 'iso' only where that target needs to override the default.
tv_unit: shutter speed as a fraction or seconds, e.g. 1/45 or 2"
